$comment: A calmer alternative to the bed in music.json, for the polished episodes (review feedback 2026-10-22: the v1 bed made reviewers nervous). Use it with SA_MUSIC_JSON=video/brand/music-calm.json for build, mix and verify; music.json stays the series bed until the owner decides. Same rules as music.json (track.file is relative to the media root and never in git; mix.py refuses any other file by SHA-256). track.mix asks the mixer for a lower bed: 8 dB under the voice and a further 6 dB while it speaks (the series bed is 3 and 9).

track.title: Spatial Adjust calm bed
track.library: None: composed and synthesised in code in this repository

measured.tool: by construction: the generator places every chord on the 72 BPM bar grid (there is no percussion for loop_points.py to find)

A candidate bed: the owner decides whether it replaces sa-bed-v1 for the series (video/approvals.md).
